heard: Eliel the Mahavite he stood Beside Jerubbiah and Josheviah Sons of Elnaam in the hall With Ithma the Moabite he stood Mishmanah, the fourth in the line Jeremiah, the fifth by design Abram, son Miel, the chief Eighty relatives stood to keep Mighty warriors, men of renown Heads of their fathers' houses down Serving David with faith and might
